lines.zh: 我四条腿走，脖子却先到。
lines.en: My four legs walk, but my neck arrives first.
My long neck sways out in front.

lines.zh: 斑纹在恶地的红土上很显眼。
lines.en: My spots show plainly on the red badlands dirt.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，脖子绕了个弯。
lines.en: I walk with my head low, neck curved.
The desert sand burns; I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我从矮树丛旁边绕过去。
lines.en: I skirt around a stand of low trees.
My tail sweeps the dry grass aside.

lines.zh: 我一步三看，脖子转个不停。
lines.en: Three looks per step; my neck never stops turning.

lines.zh: 我踏过一片风化了的石头。
lines.en: I cross a patch of weathered stone.

lines.zh: 我沿着荒原上的旧路走。
lines.en: I follow an old trail across the waste.
My shadow looks strange.

lines.zh: 我从灌木的缺口挤过去。
lines.en: I push through a gap in the brush.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的花纹一路连下去。
lines.en: The markings on my neck run in one line.
My pads hold firm on the gravel.

lines.zh: 我朝那片风大的高地走。
lines.en: I head for the windy heights.

lines.zh: 我走起来，颈子比身子还长。
lines.en: When I walk, my neck is longer than my body.
I coil my neck once.

lines.zh: 我的头顶在很高的地方。
lines.en: My head rests up very high.
I lie down, and my neck stays up.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖一下一下地动。
lines.en: My tail tip flicks.
I lick my forepaw.
My tongue is thin and long.

lines.zh: 长脖子盘起来，晒得刚好。
lines.en: My long neck coiled, I soak the sun.

lines.zh: 我数着远处有几丛灌木。
lines.en: I count the bushes in the distance.
My neck sways slowly left and right.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看看有没有猎物。
lines.en: I raise my head and look for prey.
A low sound sits in my throat.
I rest my face on my forepaws.
Too dry here; I wait for dark.

lines.zh: 你抬头才看得到我的脸。
lines.en: You have to look up to see my face.
My neck is long, so my view is wide.
Bending my head down takes a while.
You have no spots.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，你觉得怪吗。
lines.en: Does it feel strange to be looked at like this?

lines.zh: 我的头在那边，身子在这边。
lines.en: My head is over there; my body is here.
What's that in your hand?
I can come around quickly.
I'm nearer than you think.
I've drawn my neck back.
I retreat two steps and crouch low.
A streak of blood over my spots.
I grit my teeth, very low.
I watch you from my side.
I lick the blood away.

lines.zh: 我把脖子盘起来，护住伤处。
lines.en: I coil my neck to guard the wound.
My tail tip is trembling.
I'll come near again.
Meat. Just put it down.
You're holding it high; I can reach.
That meat is too dry.
I don't eat bone.
Step back, and I'll come.
My neck can do a great deal.
Stop swinging it about.
One lunge and I'm at your hand.
I can wait a little longer.
What you hit was my neck.
I made a full loop before steadying.
My neck is taller than you.
I turn sideways and squeeze past.
My head watches you from the other side.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比你的腿还长。
lines.en: My neck is longer than your leg.

lines.zh: 这一下我们都不太舒服。
lines.en: Neither of us enjoyed that.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，脖子还伸着。
lines.en: I back two steps with my neck still out.
There's another long neck out on the waste.
Our necks twine together.
Its spots are denser than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着同一个方向。
lines.en: We both watch the same direction.

lines.zh: 它趴在石头上，我在旁边。
lines.en: It lies on a rock; I'm beside it.
We don't fight over the same ground.
Its tail coils around mine.

lines.zh: 风的两个方向，我们各看一边。
lines.en: We each watch one direction of the wind.
It left; its shadow remained.
Neither of us lowered our head.

lines.zh: 长脖子一低，东西就到嘴边。
lines.en: One dip of my long neck and the thing is at my mouth.
One stretch of my neck and I have it.
Too heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我把它绕在颈上带回来。
lines.en: I wrap it around my neck and bring it back.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，塞不进牙缝。
lines.en: Too small to be worth my teeth.
It's too small to notice.
My head comes down slower than you'd think.
This smell is fresh.

lines.zh: 两条腿已经迈开，我比你快。
lines.en: My legs are already moving — I am faster than you.
I'm staring from your flank.
This is close enough for me to reach you.
The wind is coming off you.
I've drawn my neck back a little.

lines.zh: 你别看我的头，看我的手。
lines.en: Don't watch my head; watch my paws.
I've crouched.
You back off, and my head follows.
There's nothing else on this waste.
I'll come around, quickly.
I won't miss this.
You can't run fast here.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脖子放得很低。
lines.en: I follow, my neck held low.
I know this waste better than you.
Your prints stay in the dirt.
My legs aren't long, but I don't tire.
I wait for you to choose wrong.
My tail sweeps behind you.
Look back and you'll only see a shadow.
I herd you toward the drop.
The more you hurry, the slower you get.
I'm watching your ankles.
My paw pins you first.
That came from above.
You knock my head aside.
I whip with my long neck.
Teeth and claws arrive together.
Your armor has been torn open.

lines.zh: 我退开，脖子拉成一条线。
lines.en: I pull back, neck stretched straight.
Light, and very sudden.
You've been dragged half a step.
There's your blood on my paw.

lines.zh: 我从荒原的裂土上站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the cracked soil of the waste.
My neck rises first.
I landed here without moving the soil.
This badlands country suits me.
I make one lap before settling.
The wind presses dry grass at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the sand.

lines.zh: 世界上不会有第二个我。
lines.en: There won't be a second like me.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，脖子伸到最高。
lines.en: I rear up and stretch my neck to its full height.
The sun has bleached the stones.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘背面绕出来，尾巴先露。
lines.en: I come around the far side of the dune, tail first.

lines.zh: 树丛间的路，我先记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized the path through the brush.
My tail probes the grass ahead.
I've set foot on the waste.
Fire catches my fur and I spring clear.

lines.zh: 我从石坡上滚下，脖子磕到了。
lines.en: I roll down the stone slope and jar my neck.

lines.zh: 我被按进水里，呛得很惨。
lines.en: I'm forced under and choke badly.
The blast lifts me off my feet.
An arrow lodges in my neck.
Light coils around my neck.
No meat on this waste, and I've weakened.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的长颈上，我整条都麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my long neck and numbs it.
No ground here to put a paw on.
